description: should_route_mother_queue (FIND-005 fix) drops the age gate, but no boundary test was added at neg_roi_days=7 from the other side: test_no_mother_queue_route_at_6_days covers neg_roi_days=6 (False) and test_mother_queue_route_when_degraded_7d covers 7 (True). However, edge cases like neg_roi_days=0 (degenerate input) and large values (e.g. 365) are not tested, and the function silently accepts negative inputs without raising. With age_days removed, callers must ensure non-negative semantics elsewhere — this contract is unverified.
